exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb た ところ".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞たところ matches "Verb た ところ".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞たところ.
exercises.explanation: Expresses what happened immediately after completing an action.
